units.source_text: 先生的话被这只狗和小孩打断，没有说完，我到底也不得要领。

en.t: Sensei's words were interrupted by the dog and the child, and since he never finished, I never really understood his point.

units.source_text: 先生所挂念的那些财产问题，我那时完全没有想过。

en.t: At that time, I had given no thought at all to the property matters that worried Sensei.

units.source_text: 无论从我的性格还是境遇来看，根本不会为这种利害之事伤脑筋的。

en.t: Given both my temperament and my circumstances, I was not the kind of person to trouble myself over such matters of profit and loss.

units.source_text: 大概是因为我还没有进入社会，或者没有面临这类问题的缘故吧。

en.t: Perhaps it was because I had not yet entered society, or because I had never faced such problems myself.

units.source_text: 总之，对于年轻的我而言，总觉得钱的问题离自己很遥远。

en.t: In any case, to my young self, questions of money always seemed very far away.

units.source_text: 对于先生的这番话，我想刨根问底的只有一点，就是人在关键的时候，谁都会变成坏人这句话的意思。

en.t: Of all that Sensei had said, the one thing I wanted to press him on was what he meant by saying that, at a critical moment, anyone could become a bad person.

units.source_text: 单就这一句话的字面意思，我不是不能理解，但是我想要知道得更多些。

en.t: I could understand the literal meaning of the words well enough, but I wanted to know more.

units.source_text: 狗和小孩走开以后，绿叶繁茂的大园子又恢复了原来的清静。

en.t: After the dog and the child went away, the large garden thick with green leaves returned to its former quiet.

units.source_text: 我们俩都仿佛被沉默锁住的人似的，半天也没有动一动。

en.t: The two of us sat for a long while without moving, as if we had been locked in silence.

units.source_text: 这时候，晴朗的天空渐渐失去了色彩，

en.t: By then, the clear sky was gradually losing its color,

units.source_text: 眼前的树大多是枫树，树枝上新生出的青翠欲滴的嫩叶，似乎也渐渐暗淡下来。

en.t: Most of the trees before us were maples, and the fresh, dripping-green young leaves on their branches seemed to be growing dim as well.

units.source_text: 远处的马路上传来平板车发出的咯噔咯噔的响声，我猜想这大概是村里的男人拉了一车花木之类的东西去赶集吧。

en.t: From the distant road came the clattering sound of a handcart, and I imagined it was probably a village man pulling a load of plants or something of the sort to market.

units.source_text: 先生一听到这声音，仿佛突然从冥想中苏醒过来似的，马上站起来，对我说：

en.t: As soon as Sensei heard the sound, he stood up at once, as if suddenly awakened from meditation, and said to me:

units.source_text: 天虽然长了，可这么舒适，竟不知不觉地黑下来了。”

en.t: The days have grown longer, but when it is this pleasant, darkness falls before you even realize it."
